connector.name: MCP Tmux
connector.registryDescription: Model Context Protocol server that lets LLMs collaboratively drive tmux
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-tmux. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the k8ika0s account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.

env.name: MCP_TMUX_HOST
env.description: Optional default SSH host alias to use when none is provided.

env.name: MCP_TMUX_SESSION
env.description: Optional default tmux session name to use when none is provided.

env.name: TMUX_BIN
env.description: Optional path to tmux binary if not on PATH.

env.name: MCP_TMUX_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Timeout in milliseconds for tmux/ssh invocations (default 15000).

env.name: MCP_TMUX_HOSTS_FILE
env.description: Optional JSON file for per-host tmux PATH/bin overrides.
